topics.title: Antarctic genomics project gets $18.4 million
topics.summary: A new $18.4 million project called GIGA DATA will build a genomic resource for Antarctic life. The work is led by Alison Murray of the Desert Research Institute and is backed by the National Science Foundation. It will produce reference-quality genomes for more than 250 Antarctic species and analyze 600 environmental samples.
topics.detail: The project name stands for Genome Infrastructure catalyzing next Generation Antarctic Data, Access, Tools, and Analytics. The species list includes algae, invertebrates, fish, birds and marine mammals. The team also plans tens of thousands of microbial and viral genomic datasets from ecosystems such as lakes and soils.

sources.title: Mapping the genetic diversity of Antarctic life

topics.title: Kilauea eruption episode ends abruptly
topics.summary: USGS said episode 55 of the ongoing Halemaʻumaʻu eruption ended abruptly on October 17. The volcano remained at WATCH/ORANGE afterward, and officials said conditions could change rapidly. Another USGS notice said lava continued to erupt slowly within the summit crater of Great Sitkin Volcano.
topics.detail: The Kilauea notice reported the end of episode 55 at 9:03 a.m. HST on October 17. Separate USGS notices on October 15 and October 16 said Great Sitkin remained at ADVISORY/YELLOW and Kilauea remained at WATCH/ORANGE. A USGS summary page also said the Cascade Range volcanoes were at normal background activity levels.

topics.title: UCI cancels urban cycling worlds in Saudi Arabia
topics.summary: The UCI cancelled the 2026 Urban Cycling World Championships in Saudi Arabia after missile strikes on the country’s capital. Cycling Weekly reported the decision on October 16. The cancellation wipes out the planned event, and that’s a brutal one for the calendar.
